en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：

en.text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,

zhSimplified.text: 「你晓谕以色列人说：无论男女许了特别的愿，就是拿细耳人的愿，要离俗归耶和华。

footnotes.text: - 6:2 拿细耳就是归主的意思；下同

zhTraditional.text: 「你曉諭以色列人說：無論男女許了特別的願，就是拿細耳人的願，要離俗歸耶和華。

footnotes.text: - 6:2 拿細耳就是歸主的意思；下同

en.text: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

zhSimplified.text: 他就要远离清酒浓酒，也不可喝什么清酒浓酒做的醋；不可喝什么葡萄汁，也不可吃鲜葡萄和干葡萄。

zhTraditional.text: 他就要遠離清酒濃酒，也不可喝甚麼清酒濃酒做的醋；不可喝甚麼葡萄汁，也不可吃鮮葡萄和乾葡萄。

en.text: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.

zhSimplified.text: 在一切离俗的日子，凡葡萄树上结的，自核至皮所做的物，都不可吃。

zhTraditional.text: 在一切離俗的日子，凡葡萄樹上結的，自核至皮所做的物，都不可吃。

en.text: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to the LORD. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

zhSimplified.text: 「在他一切许愿离俗的日子，不可用剃头刀剃头，要由发绺长长了。他要圣洁，直到离俗归耶和华的日子满了。

zhTraditional.text: 「在他一切許願離俗的日子，不可用剃頭刀剃頭，要由髮綹長長了。他要聖潔，直到離俗歸耶和華的日子滿了。

en.text: “‘All the days that he separates himself to the LORD he shall not go near a dead body.

zhSimplified.text: 在他离俗归耶和华的一切日子，不可挨近死尸。

zhTraditional.text: 在他離俗歸耶和華的一切日子，不可挨近死屍。

en.text: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.

zhSimplified.text: 他的父母或是弟兄姊妹死了的时候，他不可因他们使自己不洁净，因为那离俗归 神的凭据是在他头上。

zhTraditional.text: 他的父母或是弟兄姊妹死了的時候，他不可因他們使自己不潔淨，因為那離俗歸上帝的憑據是在他頭上。

en.text: All the days of his separation he is holy to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 在他一切离俗的日子是归耶和华为圣。

zhTraditional.text: 在他一切離俗的日子是歸耶和華為聖。

en.text: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.

zhSimplified.text: 「若在他旁边忽然有人死了，以致沾染了他离俗的头，他要在第七日，得洁净的时候，剃头。

zhTraditional.text: 「若在他旁邊忽然有人死了，以致沾染了他離俗的頭，他要在第七日，得潔淨的時候，剃頭。

en.text: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

zhSimplified.text: 第八日，他要把两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽带到会幕门口，交给祭司。

zhTraditional.text: 第八日，他要把兩隻斑鳩或兩隻雛鴿帶到會幕門口，交給祭司。

en.text: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司要献一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭，为他赎那因死尸而有的罪，并要当日使他的头成为圣洁。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司要獻一隻作贖罪祭，一隻作燔祭，為他贖那因死屍而有的罪，並要當日使他的頭成為聖潔。

en.text: He shall separate to the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

zhSimplified.text: 他要另选离俗归耶和华的日子，又要牵一只一岁的公羊羔来作赎愆祭；但先前的日子要归徒然，因为他在离俗之间被玷污了。

zhTraditional.text: 他要另選離俗歸耶和華的日子，又要牽一隻一歲的公羊羔來作贖愆祭；但先前的日子要歸徒然，因為他在離俗之間被玷污了。

en.text: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,

zhSimplified.text: 「拿细耳人满了离俗的日子乃有这条例：人要领他到会幕门口，

zhTraditional.text: 「拿細耳人滿了離俗的日子乃有這條例：人要領他到會幕門口，

en.text: and he shall offer his offering to the LORD: one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering, one ram without defect for peace offerings,

zhSimplified.text: 他要将供物奉给耶和华，就是一只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔作燔祭，一只没有残疾、一岁的母羊羔作赎罪祭，和一只没有残疾的公绵羊作平安祭，

zhTraditional.text: 他要將供物奉給耶和華，就是一隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔作燔祭，一隻沒有殘疾、一歲的母羊羔作贖罪祭，和一隻沒有殘疾的公綿羊作平安祭，

en.text: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil with their meal offering and their drink offerings.

zhSimplified.text: 并一筐子无酵调油的细面饼，与抹油的无酵薄饼，并同献的素祭和奠祭。

zhTraditional.text: 並一筐子無酵調油的細麵餅，與抹油的無酵薄餅，並同獻的素祭和奠祭。

en.text: The priest shall present them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司要在耶和华面前献那人的赎罪祭和燔祭；

zhTraditional.text: 祭司要在耶和華面前獻那人的贖罪祭和燔祭；

en.text: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering and its drink offering.

zhSimplified.text: 也要把那只公羊和那筐无酵饼献给耶和华作平安祭，又要将同献的素祭和奠祭献上。

zhTraditional.text: 也要把那隻公羊和那筐無酵餅獻給耶和華作平安祭，又要將同獻的素祭和奠祭獻上。

en.text: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

zhSimplified.text: 拿细耳人要在会幕门口剃离俗的头，把离俗头上的发放在平安祭下的火上。

zhTraditional.text: 拿細耳人要在會幕門口剃離俗的頭，把離俗頭上的髮放在平安祭下的火上。

en.text: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved the head of his separation;

zhSimplified.text: 他剃了以后，祭司就要取那已煮的公羊一条前腿，又从筐子里取一个无酵饼和一个无酵薄饼，都放在他手上。

zhTraditional.text: 他剃了以後，祭司就要取那已煮的公羊一條前腿，又從筐子裏取一個無酵餅和一個無酵薄餅，都放在他手上。

en.text: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD. They are holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司要拿这些作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这与所摇的胸、所举的腿同为圣物，归给祭司。然后拿细耳人可以喝酒。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司要拿這些作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這與所搖的胸、所舉的腿同為聖物，歸給祭司。然後拿細耳人可以喝酒。

en.text: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows and of his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to that which he is able to afford. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’”

zhSimplified.text: 「许愿的拿细耳人为离俗所献的供物，和他以外所能得的献给耶和华，就有这条例。他怎样许愿就当照离俗的条例行。」

zhTraditional.text: 「許願的拿細耳人為離俗所獻的供物，和他以外所能得的獻給耶和華，就有這條例。他怎樣許願就當照離俗的條例行。」

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,

zhSimplified.text: 「你告诉亚伦和他儿子说：你们要这样为以色列人祝福，说：

zhTraditional.text: 「你告訴亞倫和他兒子說：你們要這樣為以色列人祝福，說：

en.text: ‘The LORD bless you, and keep you.

zhSimplified.text: 『愿耶和华赐福给你，保护你。

zhTraditional.text: 『願耶和華賜福給你，保護你。

en.text: The LORD make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.

zhSimplified.text: 愿耶和华使他的脸光照你，赐恩给你。

zhTraditional.text: 願耶和華使他的臉光照你，賜恩給你。

en.text: The LORD lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

zhSimplified.text: 愿耶和华向你仰脸，赐你平安。』

zhTraditional.text: 願耶和華向你仰臉，賜你平安。』

en.text: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们要如此奉我的名为以色列人祝福；我也要赐福给他们。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們要如此奉我的名為以色列人祝福；我也要賜福給他們。」
